description: Calibrate temperature around QKV pair 564/699 boundary
proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,652 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 18 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted relevant result is attempt-0144/micro-0018 at 1,652/99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0144/micro-0019, where QKV pair 564/699 scored 98.99% at 1,651 under temperature 1.01. Hypothesis: the next tied scalar shifts one routing margin that a local temperature adjustment can restore. The helper tests absolute multipliers 1.005, 1.015, 1.000, 1.020, 0.995, 1.025, ordered outward around 1.01, using the identical tie and official runner. Stop on first acceptance because all share 1,651 parameters, after six trials, on error, or after nine wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than a wider temperature because it resolves the measured local boundary with the smallest changes first.
summary: Calibrated QKV pair 564/699 around temperature 1.01. Absolute multiplier 1.005 scored 98.98% and was discarded; 1.015 scored 99.02% at 1,651 parameters and was retained. Frontier improved by one parameter with unchanged retained accuracy. Outcomes: 1 accept, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors; two migrations/verifications over about 2m35s. Stop reason: acceptance exhausted equal-count eligibility before the six-trial/nine-minute cap.
